claims.statement: The "mapTo..." postfix generates a new mapper or applies methods from an existing one.
claims.supports: "mapTo..." postfix option generates a new mapper or applies methods from an existing one

claims.surfaceEquivalent: A code action on the mapTo call creates the MapStruct mapper file and replaces the call with the mapper call plus injection (the new-mapper branch); applying methods of an existing mapper is the mapTo completion (RS-570, RS-571). The original's mapper creation dialog window is not checked.
